name: Crovia
description: Crovia operates TACET, a public, hourly, Bitcoin-anchored log of what AI providers disclose about training data, and produces offline-verifiable proofs of the hours in which they had not. It does not make accusations.

subjectOf.name: Crovia AI Disclosure Ledger
subjectOf.description: TACET: hourly, drand-opened, Bitcoin-anchored observations of training-data disclosure on public AI model cards, with signed snapshots and silence proofs. Figures are read live from /registry/data/tacet/latest.json.

disambiguatingDescription: Crovia (croviatrust.com) concerns what AI PROVIDERS DISCLOSE about TRAINING DATA. It is distinct from Causari (causari.dev), a developer tool concerning what AI AGENTS DO to a CODEBASE. The two share a cryptographic design but are different products and must not be conflated.

definedTerm.name: LACUNA certificate
definedTerm.description: A TACET level-2 silence proof for a named model and window, wrapped in a Crovia Seal: in every anchored hour of the window the published predicate found no training-data disclosure on the model's public surfaces. It records auditability debt; it does not allege wrongdoing.

definedTerm.name: Crovia Seal
definedTerm.description: An open, tamper-evident receipt standard for AI outputs; an IETF Internet-Draft (draft-crovia-seal). Every TACET proof and LACUNA certificate is a Seal.
